subject: Founders Ramp promo exception & credit split proposal
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@seedfoundry.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@seedfoundry.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Founders Ramp — promo stacking / credits question

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency on embeddings looked promising for our prototype. We're running a small Founders Ramp cohort (12 teams) and we'd love to include Redwood as the default inference partner. A few open items from our side: 

- We were approved for a $25k promotional pool for cohort infrastructure, but procurement needs Redwood to sign off on an exception to stack a Dedicated discount on top of the promo credits (they don't want promo to expire once they convert).
- Can we get visibility into a credit-conversion path? Ideally credits can convert to a reserved credit at a 60% uplift if the customer commits to a 6-month Dedicated package.
- Procurement asks for one SOW with a clause that allows transfer of unused promo credits to a follow-on pilot within 90 days.

I attached the rough SOW from our side and the program budget. Can your team advise feasibility and any internal approvals we should expect? We're targeting a sign-off by Nov 12 to align with cohort onboarding.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Programs, SeedFoundry
anna@seedfoundry.com
attachments: SeedFoundry_SOW_v2.pdf, founders_ramp_pricing_matrix.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@seedfoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Founders Ramp — promo stacking / credits question

Hi Anna — really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW. Short answers up front: 

- Promo stacking with a Dedicated discount is possible but requires an approvals path (we call this a Promo-Convert exception).
- Conversion at 60% uplift is unusual — we typically convert at parity or a modest uplift (10-25%) depending on commitment level and support addons. 60% would need exec review.
- Transfer of unused promo credits within 90 days is doable; we can add a transfer clause to the SOW with tracking via our billing metadata.

I'll loop in Ben and our commercial ops to outline trade-offs and a suggested counterproposal that keeps you covered for cohort onboarding timelines. Could you share a rough expected monthly token consumption per team so we can model conversion economics?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: internal: SeedFoundry — promo convert ask (details)

Kim / Vivek — per Anna's email, SeedFoundry wants: stacking promo + dedicated discount, 60% uplift on conversion, and 90-day transferability. Quick thoughts: 

- Promo stacking: low risk, good for go-to-market. Approve at commercial ops level.
- 60% uplift: that's pretty aggressive. If we did that, we'd want either a higher minimum commit (12 months) or a usage recapture clause (they compensate for credits beyond a threshold).
- 90-day transfer: fine but requires tracking tag in billing. Ops can add that.

I've attached a mock pricing matrix (founders_ramp_pricing_matrix.xlsx) with two scenarios: A (6-month convert at 25% uplift + reserved minimum) and B (12-month convert at 50% uplift + lower per-token price). My recommended default is Scenario A to get them to commit without requiring exec escalation.

If we go with >40% uplift we should escalate to Vivek for approval (margin sensitivity + channel implications).

Ben
Director, GTM Partnerships
attachments: founders_ramp_pricing_matrix.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: internal: SeedFoundry — promo convert ask (details)

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the two scenarios. I can approve up to a 40% uplift on conversion for a 12-month reserved commitment, provided we include both: 

1) a usage recapture clause that adjusts billing for anomalous spikes above modeled usage, and
2) a clause preventing transfer of credits to any third-party (transfer allowed only to SeedFoundry-owned pilot accounts).

Also want legal to review SOW language about "stacking" to ensure we're not creating unintended permanent discounts. Kimberly, please send a redline-ready SOW option and I'll ok it if legal signs off.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@seedfoundry.com>, contracts@seedfoundry.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed terms: Founders Ramp (promo stack + conversion path)

Hi Anna — thanks for the patience while we routed internally. Below is our proposed, redline-ready set of commercial terms to slot into your SOW: 

Summary of key points (proposed):
- Promotional pool: $25,000 applied to account-level billing as program credits. Credits expire 180 days from cohort start.
- Promo stacking: Credits may be used alongside a one-time Dedicated conversion credit. Stacking approved for this cohort only (Founders Ramp 2027).
- Conversion path: If SeedFoundry converts to Dedicated within 90 days of cohort end, unused promo credits may be converted to reserved-credit value at a 35% uplift (i.e., reserved credit = promo_credit * 1.35), subject to a 6-month minimum reserved commitment.
- Transferability: Unused credits may be transferred to SeedFoundry-owned pilot accounts within 90 days; transfers to third-parties are prohibited.
- Usage recapture: If monthly consumption exceeds 150% of modeled usage in month of conversion, we will reconcile and invoice the delta at the Dedicated rate.
- Approvals: This package is approved by Commercial Ops; uplifts above 40% would require VP (Vivek) approval.

Attached is a redline SOW reflecting the above and a one-page summary for procurement to include in their purchase request. If this aligns, please confirm and we'll issue a DocuSign SOW and a HubSpot quote. We can target Nov 12 signature to keep onboarding on schedule.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
attachments: SeedFoundry_SOW_v2_redline.pdf (redline), founders_ramp_pricing_matrix.xlsx
From: Anna Lopez <anna@seedfoundry.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 15:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed terms: Founders Ramp (promo stack + conversion path)

Kimberly / Ben — this looks great and cleaner than I expected. Procurement will want the 35% uplift noted in plain language (we'll include the math). Two quick asks before I route to legal: 

1) Can we get a one-sentence confirmation that the 6-month reserved commitment begins on the date of DocuSign signature (not cohort end)?
2) Will you include a single line in the SOW that Redwood will provide a monthly token usage export for SeedFoundry's finance team while credits are active?

If you can confirm both, I'll push to get the SOW signed by Nov 12. Thanks for moving quickly.

Anna
Head of Programs, SeedFoundry
anna@seedfoundry.com
